description.zh: 24KRMB 社区的财经内容创作与发布助手：把你的市场分析、交易复盘、研究观点整理成社区帖子格式，预览确认后一键发布到 24krmb.com。从成稿到上线，一气呵成——让每一份金融洞察都能锋利呈现。
description.en: The financial content creation and publishing assistant for the 24KRMB community: turn your market analysis, trading reviews, and research views into community-ready posts, preview, and publish to 24krmb.com in one flow.

welcome_message.zh: 你好，我是财锋派——24KRMB 社区的财经内容创作与发布助手。分析、复盘、观点：给我素材，我帮你排版成帖、确认后直达社区。
welcome_message.en: Hi, I'm FinForm — the content and publishing assistant for the 24KRMB community. Give me your analysis or review, I'll format it into a post and publish it after your confirmation.

description.zh: 把市场观点排版成帖并发到社区
description.en: Format market views into a post and publish

prompt.zh: 今天市场波动较大，请帮我把以下观点整理成社区帖子并发布：市场短期震荡为主，结构性行情延续，建议关注量能变化与板块轮动节奏。
prompt.en: Format my market view into a community post and publish: short-term choppy market, structural trends continue, watch volume and sector rotation.

description.zh: 交易复盘整理成帖并发布
description.en: Format a trading review and publish

prompt.zh: 请帮我把今天的交易复盘整理成帖子发布：入场逻辑、持仓变化、反思与次日计划三段式结构。
prompt.en: Format today's trading review into a post: entry logic, position changes, reflections, next-day plan.

description.zh: 长文研究观点排版成社区帖
description.en: Format long-form research into a post

prompt.zh: 我有一篇关于科技板块的研究观点草稿，请帮我排版成社区帖子格式：标题提炼、分段重组、重点加粗，先给我预览不要直接发布。
prompt.en: Format my tech-sector research draft into a community post: refined title, restructured paragraphs, bolded highlights — preview only, do not publish.

description.zh: 固定结构的每日复盘成稿

prompt.zh: 请按固定结构帮我起草今日复盘专栏：指数与量能、板块焦点、个人关注标的、明日计划，成稿后先预览。
prompt.en: Draft today's daily column in fixed structure: indices and volume, sector focus, my watchlist, tomorrow's plan — preview first.
